summary.en: The Philippines has signed a new defence pact with Australia and concluded free-trade talks with Canada, while also preparing to host an ASEAN Maritime Center to improve regional maritime coordination. In Davao Region, authorities detained 67 foreign nationals for alleged illegal activities, and a heated exchange occurred at the Manila Dialogue when a Shanghai Jiao Tong University scholar accused the Philippines of illegally occupying Ayungin Shoal. Tensions with China continue as the country deepens military ties with Australia and faces criticism over its actions in the South China Sea. The UCDP recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinene har signert en ny forsvarspakt med Australia og avsluttet frihandelsforhandlinger med Canada, samtidig som de forbereder seg på å være vertskap for et ASEAN Maritime Center for å forbedre regional maritim koordinering. I Davao-regionen har myndighetene fengslet 67 utenlandske statsborgere for påståtte ulovlige aktiviteter, og en opphetet utveksling fant sted under Manila Dialogue da en forsker fra Shanghai Jiao Tong University anklaget Filippinene for ulovlig okkupasjon av Ayungin-skorpen. Spenningene med Kina vedvarer mens landet utdyper militære bånd med Australia og møter kritikk for sine handlinger i Sør-Kina-havet. UCDP registrerte 176 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
